system_description.narrative_title: Converging Ukraine–Iran wars, energy shocks and a shifting US pivot
system_description.narrative_summary: Two theatres of conflict — Russia’s war in Ukraine and a widening Iran-related regional confrontation — are colliding and spilling into global energy, transport and supply chains. Western sanctions, votes in the US Senate and EU carve-outs are in flux while high-profile diplomatic meetings in Washington (Trump hosting Zelenskyy and Netanyahu) signal a potential recalibration of US support that feeds back into military aid, market responses and escalation dynamics. The result is an open system of interacting military strikes (notably on energy infrastructure), political bargaining over sanctions and changing alliance behavior with fast-moving feedbacks into energy prices, industrial supply chains and regional security.
system_description.scope: Active military campaigns in Ukraine and Iran-related theatres; transnational attacks on energy and transport infrastructure (refineries, ports, pipelines, storage); sanction design, legislative votes and exemptions (EU, US Senate); high-level diplomacy and presidential politics centered on US meetings; corporate and market impacts on European energy firms and logistics.
system_description.super_system: Global geopolitical-economy system (international security orders, global energy markets, and the international sanctions/financial architecture)
adjacent_subsystems: Global energy markets and upstream/downstream supply chains
US domestic politics and congressional decision-making on foreign policy
EU sanctions policy, trade law and intra-EU political consensus
Middle East regional security dynamics (Israel–Iran, Egypt, Gulf states)

variables.name: Intensity of military conflict
variables.description: Measures the overall kinetic tempo and scale of active military operations across the relevant theatres.

variables.name: Rate of transnational infrastructure attacks
variables.description: Measures the frequency per unit time of cross-border strikes and sabotage against energy, transport and logistics infrastructure.

variables.name: Severity of energy supply disruptions
variables.description: Measures the magnitude of interruptions to the availability and delivery of energy commodities and refined products.

variables.name: Stringency of sanctions measures
variables.description: Measures the overall restrictiveness and comprehensiveness of economic, trade and financial sanctions regimes in effect.

variables.name: Rate of sanctions exemptions/carve-outs
variables.description: Measures the flow rate at which exemptions, carve-outs or waivers to sanctions are granted, amended or rescinded.

variables.name: Legislative and regulatory sanction momentum
variables.description: Measures the pace and directional momentum of policymaking activity (bills, votes, regulatory changes) that alters sanctions regimes.

variables.name: Degree of diplomatic alignment
variables.description: Measures the extent to which principal actors present coordinated diplomatic positions and policy convergence on the crises.

variables.name: Rate of external military aid flows
variables.description: Measures the flow rate of material, financing and capability transfers to parties engaged in the conflicts.

variables.name: Cohesion among allied actors
variables.description: Measures the stability and cooperative coherence of security and political alignments among allied groups over time.

variables.name: Global energy price level
variables.description: Measures prevailing market prices for key energy commodities and refined fuels on global markets.

variables.name: Market risk premium for affected sectors
variables.description: Measures the additional cost of capital or price markup demanded by markets for exposure to sectors impacted by the crises.

variables.name: Logistics and transport network throughput
variables.description: Measures the volumetric flow of goods and freight moving through critical transport nodes and corridors per unit time.

variables.name: Level of industrial input scarcity
variables.description: Measures the accumulated shortfall in availability of critical industrial components, fuels or feedstocks that constrain production.

variables.name: Strategic escalation pressure
variables.description: Measures the latent propensity and systemic pressure toward wider or intensified escalation between actors or theatres.

variables.name: Public and political support for foreign engagement
variables.description: Measures the level of domestic public and political backing for continued or increased external military, financial or diplomatic engagement.

variables.name: Degree of financial transaction restrictions
variables.description: Measures the extent to which cross-border payments, banking links and financial services are constrained by controls, de-risking or sanctions.

catalysts.title: US Senate vote on Russia sanctions package
catalysts.description: Imminent Senate roll-call(s) to advance and potentially expand sanctions on Russia, likely to produce new legislative measures and votes. Outcomes will shift sanction policy and regulatory momentum in short order.
catalysts.rationale: Large majority of US Senate votes to advance Russia sanctions; Senate sets up votes; US poised to impose new Russia sanctions package.

catalysts.title: EU reconsideration of shipping/gas carve-outs
catalysts.description: Ongoing EU negotiations and political pressure to adjust carve-outs (shipping, gas) for Russia-linked trade, likely to produce exemptions or tighter rules. Outcome uncertain and will change sanction carve-outs and implementation.
catalysts.rationale: Greek shipping carve-out prompts EU rethink; TotalEnergies benefits from EU sanctions reprieve; EU faces crumbling support for new Russia sanctions.

catalysts.title: Spike in transnational drone strikes on energy and ports
catalysts.description: A continued wave of drone strikes across the Black Sea, Russian refineries, Egyptian ports and storage tankers escalates attacks on energy and transport infrastructure, disrupting flows and raising risk premia.
catalysts.rationale: Drone hits on Egyptian port gas vessels, Suez export concerns, Ukraine strikes Russian refineries, Wildberries warehouse and Black Sea gateway shut again.

catalysts.title: Russia's diesel/gasoline export ban through Jan 2027
catalysts.description: Russian extension of diesel and gasoline export bans remains in force through end-January 2027, sustaining tightness in regional fuel markets and rerouting flows.
catalysts.rationale: Russia extends diesel, gasoline export bans until end of January 2027; Russia forced to import fuel as Ukrainian strikes damage refineries.

catalysts.title: Kazakhstan talks to process Russian crude
catalysts.description: Negotiations for Kazakhstan to process Russian crude may reroute crude flows and partially alleviate Russian product shortfalls, affecting regional throughput and supply.
catalysts.rationale: Kazakhstan in talks to process Russian crude amid Russia fuel shortages; Chevron seeks to shield Kazakh assets from war spillovers.

catalysts.title: Ukraine seeks European missile-defence prototype by mid‑2027
catalysts.description: Ukraine's push to obtain and prototype a European missile-defence system by mid‑2027 will drive procurement, testing and allied support activity through next year.
catalysts.rationale: Exclusive: Ukraine wants prototype of European missile defence system by mid-2027; Zelenskiy pressed US senators for anti-ballistic systems.

catalysts.title: US meeting follow-ups shaping aid and Iran agenda
catalysts.description: Policy follow-ups and announcements after Trump’s meetings with Netanyahu and Zelenskiy could shift US aid decisions, Iran policy prioritisation and allied coordination over coming weeks.
catalysts.rationale: Trump meets Netanyahu and Zelenskiy; headlines note Trump warming to Zelensky and Iran top agenda with Netanyahu, implying near-term policy follow-ups.

catalysts.title: Erosion of EU political support for new Russia sanctions
catalysts.description: Growing political resistance within the EU to tougher Russia sanctions may slow or reshape future packages, creating momentum loss and more carve-outs.
catalysts.rationale: FT: EU faces crumbling support for new Russia sanctions; EU hesitates to target Irish plant accused of supplying Russia’s war industry.
